CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of My purpose Talents and abilities? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My purpose Talents and abilities.
   B. Say My purpose Talents and abilities has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of My purpose Talents and abilities with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use My purpose Talents and abilities to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Fall of Man.

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

5. Which response best shows understanding of King Solomon the wise ruler? (1 mark)
   A. Say King Solomon the wise ruler has no place in daily life.
   B. Use King Solomon the wise ruler to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of King Solomon the wise ruler with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing King Solomon the wise ruler.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Mount Carmel Contest? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Mount Carmel Contest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Mount Carmel Contest to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Mount Carmel Contest has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Mount Carmel Contest.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Work? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work.
   C. Say Work has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Work to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Noah and his sons? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Noah and his sons.
   B. Apply the teaching of Noah and his sons with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Noah and his sons has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Noah and his sons to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Birth of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth of Moses.
   C. Say The Birth of Moses has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Birth of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

11. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Use The call of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The call of Moses.
   C. Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The call of Moses has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of A hand writes on the wall? (1 mark)
   A. Say A hand writes on the wall has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of A hand writes on the wall with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing A hand writes on the wall.
   D. Use A hand writes on the wall to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible as a Guide? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Bible as a Guide to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible as a Guide.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Bible as a Guide with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Bible as a Guide has no place in daily life.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Family Unity? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Family Unity.
   B. Say Family Unity has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Family Unity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Family Unity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Peter’s miraculous rescue and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Friendship Formation 3 5.2 Human Sexuality 3 5.3 Sanctity of Life 3 5.4 Alcohol, and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Friendship formation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
